description: Accepts any valid Philippine government-issued photo ID. The verification pipeline resolves this umbrella type to the specific subtype detected by the template classifier.
notes: When document_type=government_id is submitted, the ORB template matcher attempts to classify the specific ID type. The resolved type is stored in document_type_detected. OCR field extraction then uses the resolved type. A mismatch flag is only raised if the detected type is NOT in accepted_subtypes.
